The [[Lair (system)|Lloelldegh system]] (aka ''"'''Lair'''"'') is centered on [[Kneng (star)|Kneng]], an ordinary yellow main sequence star.
* The system consists of seven [[World|major planetary bodies]], one [[planetoid belt]], and three [[gas giant]] worlds.

== Description (Specifications) ==
=== Stellar Data ===
'''[[Kneng (star)|Kneng]]''', the system primary, is a solitary star.
* It is a yellow main sequence.

{{MonostellarSystem
|name            = [[Kneng (star)|Kneng]]
|primary         = G5 V
|PrimaryName     = Kneng
|PrimaryNotes    = None
}}

=== The Lair System ===
[[File:System Map Lair Basic.png|700 px]]
<br> 
: <small> ''A simple chart depicting the Lair system. </small>

=== Inner System ===
'''[[Og Orz (world)|Og Orz]]''': [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] YS00000-0, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 0.08 AU]] <small>'''(Companion Orbit)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Day|8.5 standard days]]. <br> It is an insignificant scorched ball of rock, dwarfed by many of the system's moons. Its rocky metal-poor structure discourages prospecting efforts. 

'''[[Erzikh Dhadh (world)|Erzikh Dhadh]]:''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] H310300-F, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 0.21 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 0)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Day|36.3 standard days]]. <br> It is a small rocky world that retains a [[Trace Atmosphere|trace carbon dioxide atmosphere]]. Unlike Og Orz, [[Hot World|intensely hot]] Erhihk Dhadh is rich with minerals and has enormous mining potential.
* Erzikh Dhadh has been the site of many boom / bust mining operations focused on harvesting various different minerals in the millennia since the [[Vargr]] first achieved space flight.
* In [[1113]], the [[Dhufokh Corporation]] located major deposits of rare crystals deep within the world's crust. [[Dhufokh Corporation|Dhufokh]] quickly laid claim to the deposits, but the company is unsure how to proceed. A research station was designed and built to harness this new discovery.

'''[[Foulours (world)|Foulours]]:''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] Y630000-0, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 0.39 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 1)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Day|91.8 standard days]]. <br> It is a [[Hot World|very hot]], [[Poor World|very poor]] [[desert world]] that is unusual in that it retains a [[Very Thin Atmosphere|very thin oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere]] despite its [[Celsius|high surface temperatures]].
* Unusually for an [[Inner World|inner system world]], it retains a [[Planetary Ring|ring system]] and a [[Natural Satellite|single major moon]].
* It has extremely primitive single celled thermophilic native life that survives in the most marginal of conditions.

----
==== ''Habitable Zone'' ====
: '''[[Lair (world)|Lloelldegh]] ([[Lair (world)|Lair]]):''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] A8859B9-F, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 0.70 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 2)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Day|220.6 standard days]]. <br> It is a [[Temperate World|temperate]] [[garden world]] and the '''[[Homeworld]] of the [[Vargr]]'''.
:* Two small planetoid moons, ''Errgh'' and ''Sanko'', orbit close to the world at 2 and 4 diameters distance, respectively.
:* A small [[Vacuum World|vacuum moon]] ''(Ouksado Fan)'' orbits at approximately 60 diameters.
----

'''[[Goullaengrak (world)|Goullaengrak]]:''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] LGG ([[Kilometer|diameter 220,000 km]]), [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 1.05 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 3)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Day|405 standard days]]. <br> It is a huge [[gas giant]], the largest planetary body within the system
* It has a spectacular [[Planetary Ring|double ring system]] and six [[Natural Satellite|major moons]].
** One moon, ''Vadze Aengkoe'', was the site of an early [[Terraforming]] project and saw a major space battle in the early years of [[Vargr]] expansion out from [[Lair (world)|Lair]].
** Another satellite, ''Fi Itsoudzi'', today plays host to a small tourist hostel.

'''[[Garzingnall Belt (world)|Garzingnall Belt]]:''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] Y000100-E, a mean width of [[Astronomical Unit|around 0.5 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 4)'''</small>, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 1.66 AU]], with a mean orbital period of [[Year|2.21 standard years]]. <br> The once rich belt has been largely mined out.
* It supports a small indigenous population of miners, but most prospectors who come to the belt are transients or optimists. 

'''Saghurrkhoer:''' [[Kilometer|diameter 80,000 km]], [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 2.69 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 5)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Year|4.55 standard years]]. <br> Considered to be a large [[gas giant]], though it displays characteristics more closely related to smaller [[Gas Giant|ice giant worlds]].
* It has two sizable but otherwise insignificant [[Natural Satellite|major moons]].

=== Outer system ===
'''Ngolkfaedh:''' [[Kilometer|diameter 60,000 km]], [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 5.42 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 6)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Year|13.01 standard years]]. <br> The outermost and smallest of the system's three [[gas giant]] worlds. It is a large example of an [[Gas Giant|ice giant world]].
* It has four [[Natural Satellite|major moons]]
** Its innermost satellite, ''Uzil'', has rudimentary living facilities. A government science team currently occupies those facilities, engaged in astronomical studies. 

'''[[Rrallan Ang (world)|Rrallan Ang]]:''' [[Universal World Profile|UWP]] H9A5239-E, [[Astronomical Unit|orbiting at 11.18 AU]] <small>'''(Orbit 7)'''</small>, with an orbital period of [[Year|38.56 standard years]]. <br> It is a large, [[Frozen World|frigidly cold]], ammonia-swathed rock with hydrocarbon seas.
* The leaders of [[Lair (world)|Lair's]] nations were ousted from power in [[923]]. Many of those administrators voluntarily took up a life of exile on lonely Rrallan Ang. Their descendants today number in the hundreds.

==== Far Outer System ====
Three small [[vacuum world]]s (all with [[Universal World Profile|UWPs]] of Y100000-0) orbit at the very outer edge of the system  <small>'''~ (Orbit 11)'''</small>.
* All three share a similar orbital distance from [[Kneng (star)|Kneng]]: 
** The innermost world orbits at [[Astronomical Unit|approximately 150 AU]] and has an orbital period of [[Year|1895 Years]].
** The middle world orbits at [[Astronomical Unit|approximately 160 AU]] and has an orbital period of [[Year|2088 Years]].
** The outermost world orbits at [[Astronomical Unit|approximately 175 AU]] and has an orbital period of [[Year|2388 Years]].
* None retain [[Natural Satellite|any significant satellites]].

They are collectively referred to as '''Arraghar Eroghara''', or the ''three lost brothers''.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
Around [[-3810]] the [[Vargr]] discovered [[Jump Drive|jump technology]] and began [[First Vargr Diaspora|an era of expansion]]. They had been exploring within the [[Lair (world)|Lair system]] for centuries before, using [[NAFAL|sublight drives]] to found outposts and colonies on some of its worlds and moons.
